==Biography==
=== 2015 Season ===
In October 2014, Tallywhacka was originally brought onto the Legacy roster as a top laner, replacing the struggling [[Minkywhale]].<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/LegacyEsportsLoL/posts/363472777161412 Legacy eSports' Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref>. Prior to [[OPL/2015 Season/Split 1|OPL 2015 Split 1]], Tallywhacka swapped roles with teammate [[Cardrid]], returning to his comfort role. Minkywhale would later return to the starting lineup as a top laner, replacing Cardrid. Legacy placed third in the [[OPL/2015 Season/Split 1 Playoffs|Split 1 playoffs]] and then second in the [[OPL/2015 Season/Split 2 Playoffs|Split 2 Playoffs]].
=== 2016 Season ===
In December 2015, Tallywhacka shortened his name to '''Tally''' and switched back to top lane, as [[k1ng]] joined the roster and replaced him as AD carry.<ref>[http://legacyesports.com.au/2015/12/28/changes-foundations-2016/ Legacy eSports'site update] ''legacyesports.com.au''</ref>.

== Trivia ==
* Known for his {{ci|Riven}} at PAX Australia 2014, and his {{ci|Kalista}} since the inception of the Oceanic Pro League (OPL).
* Dropped out of high school to pursue a full-time gaming career.
* Enjoys playing osu! in queue and World of Warcraft in his free time
* Used to duo queue with North American support player [[Matlife]] prior to transferring to the Oceania server.
